text:
maya: quick postmortem follow-up from today's streaming incident. TL;DR — we saw a cluster of long-tail timeouts combined with partial responses during a scale-up window. Root hypothesis: client/server handshake/backoff mismatch + transient server-side queueing. I sketched some remedial actions below; please ack and take ownership or nominate someone.
aj: i'll own reconnect logic + client SDK patch. plan: add jittered exponential backoff, tighten handshake retry window, and surface a clearer client-side error for partial chunks. i'll open a draft PR by Wed EOD and push a staging test by Fri. @maya
simon: taking timeout tuning and server circuit-breaker thresholds. need a reproducible client sim to stress handshake timings — @aj can you share? i'll also add a temporary inflight cap per-session while we test.
liz: i'll build the telemetry + dashboards. proposed metrics: partial_chunk_rate, handshake_fail_rate, session_backlog_p50/p95, inflight_per_session. will add alerts for sustained partial_chunk_rate and handshake failures. ETA: next Wed.
priya: i'll own the postmortem doc + runbook updates. will add a "non-streaming fallback" checklist and a step-by-step mitigation playbook for oncall. proposing weekly check-ins for 4 weeks to monitor recurrence.
incident-bot: created tickets STREAM-4821 (reconnect-sdk), STREAM-4822 (timeout-tuning), STREAM-4823 (telemetry-dashboards), STREAM-4824 (runbook-update).
aj: client sim link: https://git.internal/redwood/stream-client-sim — i'll push a reproducible script with configs for short/long handshake windows (2s/10s) and a heavy concurrent session mode. use that to reproduce queueing.
simon: hypothesis: autoscaler spin-up + cold worker queueing causes head-of-line blocking for some sessions, producing partial responses and long tail. intermediate mitigation: cap inflight_per_session=8 as a low-risk canary tonight, roll to broader cohort if stable. i'll monitor error rates and RTT.
maya: summary/owners & deadlines: aj -> SDK/reconnect PR by Wed EOD; simon -> canary inflight cap tonight, full rollout by Fri if stable; liz -> dashboards/alerts next Wed; priya -> doc+runbook by Mon. weekly follow-up in #incidents Thu 10:00am for 4 weeks; please update STREAM tickets with PR links and test logs.
liz: :thumbsup: i'll add an escalation in the alert (PagerDuty) if partial_chunk_rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m. will include playbook steps (rollback to non-streaming, scale manual, contact infra).
aj: also adding a server-side guarded fallback flag to forcibly disable streaming for heavy workloads (low-risk toggle). i'll include rollout plan and KILL switch in the PR.
maya: good progress — i'll post a short summary to #all-hands once SDK PR is merged and the canary completes. thanks everyone, and please keep the ticket comments up to date with timestamps and artifacts.
